propositions: Attestation staleness messages currently name a fixed, fictional list (description/AC/file_impact/children) rather than identifying which component actually changed, obscuring the root cause.

Ticking an AC checkbox does not invalidate attestations because checkbox state is normalized out by _normalize_checkbox_state before hashing; this is already functionally correct but diagnostically opaque.
Pre-330c attestations hashed raw descriptions and fail to grandfather when boxes are ticked, producing spurious stale-material verdicts with no identifiable changed component.
Per-component fingerprints must be stored in the signed manifest as additive material-part lines so the explanation at read time matches what the reviewer actually saw.

Attestation error surfaces (unsigned message, stale-reopened, dependency changes, child-closure details, signing failures) must all name the specific changed components or reasons rather than generic fixed lists.
